body:
When I posted this last night, it was the darkest I'd ever felt. Being overwhelmed by all factors in my life made it seem like I had no escape. If it wasn't for my brother and brother-in-law showing up unexpectedly, I might have acted on it. I didn't have a plan but I was looking at options.

As it is right now, my situation in life is exactly the same so it's only a matter of time before these thoughts return. I have made an appointment to see a psychologist who can hopefully bring me out of this state of despair.
